clauses.reason: Executive Order 8774 (June 10, 1941; 6 FR 2845) modifies Executive Order No. 8738 of April 21, 1941 by one operative paragraph: subject to the 20,000-bag mocha allocation that EO 8738 set for entries from April 22 to August 31, 1941, coffee produced in countries not signatories of the Inter-American Coffee Agreement may be entered for consumption up to the unfilled balance of the total quota for those countries, as determined under the Agreement, for the quota year ending September 30, 1941. The order says it becomes effective on the third day after it is filed with the Division of the Federal Register; the held text records filing on June 11, 1941, so it took effect on June 14, 1941. The permission is limited by its own terms to the quota year ending September 30, 1941, so it expired when that quota year ended. I record the end as September 30, 1941 inclusive (the permission runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading is that it ended when October 1, 1941 began. I found no earlier end: the held 1989 Office of the Federal Register codification table (jobs/peano-formulario/output/texts/d1/d19ee411d92336529902c4846a75044fdcb1e67d965620dbad1c6fb4c94c2b45.txt) lists EO 8738 only as 'See: EO 8774, June 10, 1941' and EO 8774 only as 'Amends: EO 8738', and no held text revokes either order before September 30, 1941. Whether the unfilled balance was exhausted before that date is not shown by any held source and is not treated as an end.

research_rationale:
EO 8774 (Modifying Executive Order No. 8738 of April 21, 1941, Allocating by Types the Coffee Quota for Countries Not Signatories of the Inter-American Coffee Agreement; 6 FR 2845) was read in full from the held Federal Register original. It is a time-limited import permission tied to one quota year, so its sole clause ended by its own terms at the end of the quota year on September 30, 1941, and the whole order is not in force on 2026-10-14. The status decision for this member records 'no' on that own-terms ending. The single catalog observation (Amends: EO 8738, April 21, 1941) describes what this order did to another order; the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09, eCFR as of 2026-10-14, Federal Register catalog and saved order texts) found no later instrument acting on EO 8774.

savings.reason: EO 8774 contains no savings clause. Entries of coffee made during the quota year were completed acts under a permission that has expired, and no held source preserves any pending right, duty or proceeding under it after September 30, 1941.
